_readme: Single source of truth for the AgentProvider proto enum's human-facing vocabulary: the display name each side renders, the kebab-case CLI alias, and the extra parse aliases the CLI and admin RPCs accept. task generate-contracts cross-checks the keys against the proto enum (every non-UNSPECIFIED value MUST appear here, no extras) and emits Go tables (agentlabels consumes them) and the TS record (AgentProviderIcon's agentProviderLabel consumes it). Adding a provider is now: add the enum value, add this entry, run task generate -- a value without metadata fails the build instead of rendering blank on one side.
